info.cls_ename: Master's Program in English Studies, Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch:
本課程於前半段介紹文學翻譯涉及之理論與議題，並介紹東西之文學翻譯歷史；並於後半段，以個案研究的方式，從英譯中及中譯英(外)的領域，各選一個案，以展現前半學期所討論的現象以理論。
在這樣的宏觀角度下，呈現的另一種看待文學翻譯的視野，以俾學生深入了解並增進文學翻譯相關之實務、立論與評論等多方面之素養與實力。
description.describe_eh:
The course offers an introduction to the theories of literary translation and the translational history of important key works. Both of the Western and Eastern traditions will be covered with the goal of an over-all understanding and appreciation of the significance and relevance of the role that translation has played in literature since the dawn of the literay traditions. 
It is crucial to provide case studies as an embodiment of the criticism and theories. The latter half of the term includes two case studies of literary translation between, basically, Chinese and English literary traditions: the English translation of Han Shan and the Chinese translation of Edward Fitzgerald’s Rubaiyat by Omar Khayyam.
